items.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants

sentences.en: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare 2026年第三季度DDoS威胁报告：更多的群体，更少的巨头。

sentences.en: Welcome to the 26th edition of Cloudflare's DDoS Threat Report.
This edition covers the third quarter of 2026 — July, August, and September — and returns the series to its quarterly cadence following the combined H1 2026 volume.

The analysis is produced by Cloudforce One , Cloudflare's Threat Intelligence organization, providing a comprehensive analysis of the evolving threat landscape of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks based on data from the Cloudflare network .
Key insights Short-burst, low-bandwidth attacks lasting under 10 minutes and 1 Gbps surged by 208%.

Conversely, hyper-volumetric attacks exceeding 1 Tbps plummeted by nearly 69% from Q2, possibly a reflection of law enforcement actions against four major Internet of Things (IoT) botnets earlier in the year.
However, variants continue to emerge, proving that IoT botnets remain a durable, high-volume threat to network infrastructure.
Threat actors dramatically shifted their reflection and amplification tactics, abruptly abandoning CLDAP floods, which collapsed by 99.5% quarter-over-quarter.
Instead, attackers pivoted heavily toward other connectionless protocols, driving a 215% surge in DNS amplification and a 122% increase in general UDP floods.
Attack targets broadened significantly across both industries and geographies, with the United States reclaiming the most-attacked position from China.
Canada and Israel experienced sharp spikes in targeted attacks — jumping 10 and 7 spots respectively — while juggling geopolitical tensions, trade disputes, and contentious domestic events.
At the same time, the operational focus shifted away from media organizations toward a wider array of industry targets, including consumer services, Internet infrastructure, and adult entertainment.

items.title: From Working Group to SIG Architecture: spotlight on AI Conformance

sentences.en: From Working Group to SIG Architecture: spotlight on AI Conformance.

In this SIG Architecture spotlight we talked with Janet Kuo (Google) and Yuan Tang (Red Hat) about the journey of AI Conformance in Kubernetes, from the initial Working Group to the integration SIG Architecture as a subproject.
Introductions Frederico Muñoz and Kirti Goyal (FK): Hi Janet, Yuan, and thank you for the opportunity to learn a bit more about AI Conformance.
Can you tell us a bit about yourselves and how you got involved in Kubernetes?
Janet Kuo : I'm a Senior Staff Software Engineer at Google and have been a Kubernetes maintainer since 2015, joining the community just as we were racing toward the 1.0 launch.
I started my journey writing the core workload controllers that standardized how applications are orchestrated on Kubernetes.
Today, I lead SIG Apps as a Co-chair & TL, and also lead the AI Conformance program .
My current focus is to ensure Kubernetes remains the best platform for the next generation of workloads, such as AI.
Yuan Tang : I’m a Senior Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat, where I lead the development of our AI platform and drive our upstream open source strategy.
I became involved in Kubernetes early on by fostering collaborations between the Kubernetes community and projects I was leading, including Kubeflow, Argo, and KServe.
I later helped found and lead WG Serving and the AI Conformance program, advancing innovation and strengthening community collaboration around running AI workloads on Kubernetes.
Program, Working Group, Subproject: the many shapes of AI Conformance FK: AI Conformance started as a CNCF Program, was it then you got involved?

sentences.en: An excerpt was published by Vanity Fair last Thursday, and immediately drew a furious response from Kushner, who called its claims “completely insane”.

sentences.en: The book contains numerous allegations about Kushner, whose father-in-law is Trump and who has served as one of his top diplomatic envoys in the Middle East – the most explosive of which are claims linking him to huge bank accounts allegedly funded by Gulf states.
sentences.zh: 这本书包含许多关于库什纳的指控，库什纳的岳父是特朗普，他曾担任他在中东的最高外交使节之一，其中最具爆炸性的是将他与据称由海湾国家资助的巨额银行账户联系起来的说法。

items.title: EU backs away from offer to Canada to start ‘associate member’ talks

sentences.en: EU backs away from offer to Canada to start ‘associate member’ talks.
sentences.zh: 欧盟放弃向加拿大提出的启动“准成员”谈判的提议。

sentences.en: Watered-down version of statement to be issued at end of Montreal summit instead offers ‘ever closer association’ The EU has backed away from its offer to Canada to start talks on becoming an “associate member” after disagreements between member states just as an EU-Canada summit was set to begin in Montreal.
sentences.zh: 在蒙特利尔峰会结束时发布的淡化版本的声明反而提供了“更紧密的联系”欧盟已经放弃了向加拿大提出的在成员国之间出现分歧后开始谈判成为“准成员”的提议，就像欧盟-加拿大峰会将在蒙特利尔开始一样。

sentences.en: A draft of a joint statement to be issued after the end of the summit, which runs Thursday and Friday, showed a watered-down version offering “an ever closer association of Canada to the EU, short of full membership itself”.
sentences.zh: 周四和周五举行的峰会结束后将发布的联合声明草案显示了一个淡化的版本，该版本提供了“加拿大与欧盟的关系越来越紧密，而不是正式成员本身”。

sentences.en: US ambassador suggests Trump could blame Canada if midterms don’t go his way.
sentences.zh: 美国大使表示，如果中期选举不顺利，特朗普可能会责怪加拿大。

sentences.en: Pete Hoekstra, controversial US ambassador to Canada, has also accused Canadian officials of interfering in US elections The US ambassador has suggested Canada could be blamed if Republicans perform poorly in next week’s midterm elections, the latest intervention from a controversial figure who has been accused of inflaming a bitter dispute that has angered and baffled residents of both countries.
sentences.zh: 备受争议的美国驻加拿大大使皮特·霍克斯特拉（ Pete Hoekstra ）也指责加拿大官员干涉美国大选。美国大使表示，如果共和党人在下周的中期选举中表现不佳，加拿大可能会受到指责，这是一位有争议的人物的最新干预，他被指控煽动了一场激烈的争端，这场争端激怒并困扰了两国居民。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, CTV news reported that Pete Hoekstra told business leaders at a closed door meeting that if a number of swing races – including Maine and Michigan – go to the Democrats, it could make things harder for Canada because Donald Trump might try to blame the loss on it.
sentences.zh: 周三， CTV新闻报道称，皮特·霍克斯特拉（ Pete Hoekstra ）在一次闭门会议上告诉商界领袖，如果包括缅因州和密歇根州在内的一些摇摆比赛转向民主党，可能会让加拿大陷入困境，因为唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）可能会试图将损失归咎于此。

items.title: Publish Visual Studio Marketplace extensions securely with Trusted Publishing

sentences.en: Publish Visual Studio Marketplace extensions securely with Trusted Publishing.
sentences.zh: 使用受信任的发布安全地发布Visual Studio Marketplace扩展。

sentences.en: We are excited to announce Trusted Publishing for Visual Studio Marketplace —a simpler and safer way to publish Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio extensions from GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines without storing a long-lived Azure DevOps personal access token (PAT).
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴地宣布适用于Visual Studio Marketplace的Trusted Publishing ，这是一种更简单、更安全的方式，可以从GitHub Actions或Azure Pipelines发布Visual Studio Code和Visual Studio扩展，而无需存储长期存在的Azure DevOps个人访问令牌(PAT)。

sentences.en: Trusted Publishing uses federated identity to verify your release workflow and grant access for the publish—no publishing secret to store or rotate.
sentences.zh: 受信任的发布使用联合身份验证发布工作流，并为发布授予访问权限，无需存储或轮换发布密钥。

sentences.en: Why Trusted Publishing?
sentences.zh: 为什么选择值得信赖的发布？

sentences.en: Automated Marketplace publishing has traditionally required storing a PAT as a CI/CD secret.
sentences.zh: 传统上，自动化市场发布需要将PAT存储为CI/CD机密。

sentences.en: Trusted Publishing offers a safer alternative: No long-lived secrets —there is no publishing credential to store or rotate in your CI/CD system.
sentences.zh: 受信任的发布提供了一种更安全的替代方案：没有长久的秘密-没有发布凭据可以在您的CI/CD系统中存储或轮换。

sentences.en: Short-lived access —for GitHub Actions, Marketplace issues a temporary credential that expires after 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 短期访问-对于GitHub Actions ， Marketplace会颁发临时凭据，该凭据将在15分钟后过期。

sentences.en: Federated identity —Marketplace trusts a configured GitHub workflow or Azure Pipelines workload identity.
sentences.zh: 联合身份-市场信任已配置的GitHub工作流或Azure管道工作负载身份。

sentences.en: Existing PAT-based publishing continues to work, so you can adopt Trusted Publishing when you are ready.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于PAT的发布仍然有效，因此您可以在准备就绪时采用可信发布。

sentences.en: How it works The CI/CD system presents its federated identity to Visual Studio Marketplace.
sentences.zh: 工作原理CI/CD系统将其联合标识呈现给Visual Studio Marketplace。

sentences.en: Marketplace verifies the GitHub Trusted Publishing policy or the Azure Pipelines workload identity.
sentences.zh: Marketplace验证GitHub受信任发布策略或Azure管道工作负载标识。

sentences.en: The publishing tool uses the verified identity to publish the extension without a PAT.
sentences.zh: 发布工具使用经过验证的身份在没有PAT的情况下发布扩展。

items.title: GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack

sentences.en: GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack.
sentences.zh: GitHub Universe 2026 ：演进堆栈的每一层。

sentences.en: Our jobs as developers are changing.
sentences.zh: 我们作为开发人员的工作正在发生变化。

sentences.en: In a couple of years, we ve gone from writing every line of code to working with AI assistants to orchestrating fleets of agents.
sentences.zh: 在几年的时间里，我们从编写每一行代码到与人工智能助理合作，再到编排代理车队。

sentences.en: But the goal hasn t changed: ship completed software work.
sentences.zh: 但目标并没有改变：船只完成了软件工作。

sentences.en: A feature, a bug fix, a security fix.
sentences.zh: 功能、错误修复、安全修复。

sentences.en: Completed work, not more code, is the output that matters.
sentences.zh: 完成的工作，而不是更多的代码，才是重要的输出。

sentences.en: Today at GitHub Universe , we shared our vision for GitHub as the most comprehensive software delivery system in the world.
sentences.zh: 今天在GitHub Universe上，我们分享了GitHub作为世界上最全面的软件交付系统的愿景。

sentences.en: We introduced products that bring that vision to life and showed how we re rebuilding the infrastructure underneath it.
sentences.zh: 我们推出了将这一愿景变为现实的产品，并展示了我们如何重建其下方的基础设施。

sentences.en: Our vision: From idea to completed software The SDLC is no longer a linear path from planning to coding to testing to deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们的愿景：从构思到完成软件SDLC不再是从规划到编码、从测试到部署的线性路径。

sentences.en: A code change, a request from a colleague, or a production metric can trigger work anywhere in the system.
sentences.zh: 代码更改、同事的请求或生产指标可以在系统中的任何地方触发工作。

sentences.en: Most of us (and our agents) jump between different stages, depending on the task at hand.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人（和我们的代理）在不同阶段之间跳跃，具体取决于手头的任务。

sentences.en: Developers set the direction, make decisions, and stay accountable for what ships.
sentences.zh: 开发人员设定方向，做出决策，并对船舶负责。

items.title: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents

sentences.en: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents.
sentences.zh: Octoverse ：随着开发人员与代理商一起构建，承诺、推动在2026年达到新高。

sentences.en: Developers pushed code to GitHub 17.9 billion times in the past 12 months, more than in 2024 and 2025 combined.
sentences.zh: 在过去的12个月里，开发人员将代码推送到GitHub的次数达到了179亿次，超过了2024年和2025年的总和。

sentences.en: Behind that number are developers building what interests them and what their communities need.
sentences.zh: 这个数字背后是开发人员构建他们感兴趣的内容以及他们的社区需要的内容。

sentences.en: In Nepal, one developer built a flood bulletin on GitHub Pages with verified information on roads, rescue, weather, and power.
sentences.zh: 在尼泊尔，一位开发人员在GitHub Pages上构建了一个洪水公告，其中包含有关道路、救援、天气和电力的经过验证的信息。

sentences.en: It has since grown into Gati , a Nepali-first relay of official disaster alerts that runs on GitHub Pages and Actions.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，它已经发展成为Gati ，这是尼泊尔第一个在GitHub页面和行动上运行的官方灾难警报中继器。

sentences.en: Elsewhere, developers at NASA s Jet Propulsion Laboratory are creating software designed to run programs aboard spacecraft , and fans built open-source firmware that lets people customize their e-readers .
sentences.zh: 在其他地方，美国宇航局喷气推进实验室（ NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory ）的开发人员正在开发用于在航天器上运行程序的软件，而粉丝们则构建了开源固件，让人们可以定制他们的电子阅读器。

sentences.en: Curiosity, aimed in every direction, at a scale GitHub hasn t seen before.
sentences.zh: 好奇心，以GitHub从未见过的规模瞄准各个方向。

sentences.en: That growth happened quickly.
sentences.zh: 这种增长发生得很快。

sentences.en: Partway through the year, activity on GitHub bent sharply upward, just as agents went from something developers were trying out to something they were working alongside.
sentences.zh: 在一年中， GitHub上的活动急剧向上弯曲，就像代理商从开发人员正在尝试的东西变成了他们正在一起工作的东西一样。

sentences.en: Developers picked from more models than ever and built in industries we are highlighting in this report for the first time, from health care to agriculture.
sentences.zh: 从医疗保健到农业，开发人员从比以往任何时候都更多的模型中挑选并建立了我们在本报告中首次强调的行业。

sentences.en: Octoverse is our chance to step back and look at the whole picture.
sentences.zh: Octoverse是我们退后一步，看看全貌的机会。

sentences.en: This year, that picture is bigger than ever.
sentences.zh: 今年，这张照片比以往任何时候都要大。
